source_scope.detail_policy: Complete parsed member, unique nonmissing main key, zero orphans. Retain repeated detail occurrences; unresolved object multiplicity excludes.

supplemental_semantics.authority: Reviewed external evidence is supplied input. Shape/content binding validates consistency, not legal authority. No actual supplement was recovered or used.
supplemental_semantics.fraction_basis: Native land fraction is a parcel ownership interest. Compare to the evidenced complete interest required for this dwelling; never reinterpret it as a dwelling transfer fraction.
supplemental_semantics.positive_rights: Every private dwelling transfers 1/1; each linked common/ancillary and land interest equals the complete required interest. Native status and fractions agree.
supplemental_semantics.positive_dwelling: Exactly one mapped private residential dwelling with explicit one-unit count, compatible main count, single agreeing floor and exact sum of transferred detail area. Common portions must identify the same dwelling and have native common use.

area.field: 建物移轉總面積平方公尺
area.basis: Registered transferred building area; may include common and ancillary portions. No interior/net/usable-area claim.

availability.EXACT_PUBLICATION_TIME: Timezone-aware evidenced timestamp bound to exact archive/version.
availability.DATE_ONLY_PUBLICATION: Eligible from next midnight Asia/Taipei, converted to UTC; not a fabricated intraday publication instant.
availability.CONSERVATIVE_UPPER_BOUND: Eligible only from the evidenced bound, including exact current verified HTTPS retrieval. Earlier publication remains unknown.
availability.SYSTEM_FIRST_SEEN: No standalone public availability assertion; excludes under public-information framing.
availability.current_real_evidence: Two exact current retrieval upper bounds only. No 2023–2026 historical fold availability authenticated.

revision_policy: Reuse explicit predecessor selection before admission. Full supplied semantic/detail evidence participates in same-version conflicts. No changed-ID inferred linkage; ambiguous or unknown namespace/cancellation state excludes.
clock_policy: Logical snapshot/cutoff is configuration. Actual ingestion/transformation remain null without captured event evidence; no system replay assertion.

chronology.historical_membership: Re-select the entire supplied version ledger at each block freeze and bind its digest. Global-cutoff membership/version differences reject the proposal, including later cancellations; no historical population is reconstructed from current admitted rows alone.
chronology.maturity: Train and validation labels before next block; calibration labels before test. Test labels by separate observation cutoff. No universal lag guessed.
chronology.primary_split: Contiguous chronological; no random fallback. Unknown coverage/insufficient volume produces no assignments.

baseline_history: Full version ledger as of min(prediction_at, fitting_cutoff), then eligibility, strict earlier effective time, subject-family exclusion and required frozen fitting-family membership. Unknown evidence abstains. No baseline estimation or model fitting performed.
gate_policy: Nonempty semantic/PIT cohort, proper chronology and two matching nonempty builds remain mandatory. Consistency tests or matching empty outputs do not authorize ML-B.
